title: How far can I broadcast LoRa packets WITHOUT a radio? - LoLRa
summary: CNLohr explains how he made an ESP32 produce valid LoRa packets without a LoRa radio, using aliasing and clever signal tricks. It walks through the RF math and shows how far the signals reach.
why: HN cites it as a striking example of radio hacking with commodity chips.

quote.text: you can still get several km of range. Truly crazy stuff.
